text:
Alex: Quick follow-up from last night's p95 latency spike (22:13 UTC). We captured postmortem actions but need to finalize SLO edits and assign owners for dashboard + remediation timeline. Key asks: 1) should we shift p95 target from 300ms -> 350ms for read-heavy routes? 2) Who owns runbook edits for the recurring cache-warmup pattern? 3) Dashboard quick fixes and alert thresholds?

Maya: Short notes — spike looked like a KV cache miss cascade, added tail amplification ~10%. Agree to a temporary SLO relax for canary group only. @Alex, @Erin pls confirm.

Erin: I can own dashboard + alert changes. Plan: push patch to SLO dashboard and add throughput vs latency panel. ETA: EOD Thu. I'll open a PR and link it to the epic.

Alex: Sounds good. Assigning action items in thread so we have clear owners:
- Erin -> Dashboard + alerts (ETA Thu EOD)
- Maya -> Runbook edit + orchestrator scaling policy (ETA Fri)
- Alex -> Canary SLO policy + rollback rules (ETA Mon)
- SRE-Bot -> create remediation epic & auto-link incidents

SRE-Bot: Created epic SRE-EPIC-789 and linked incident 189-2026. New issues: SRE-345 (dashboard), SRE-346 (runbook), SRE-347 (canary policy).

Maya: For the SLO change proposal: I propose adding a temporary "canary-slo" label and adjusting p95 to 350ms for the canary cohort for 24h, then reevaluate metrics and error budget consumption. If OK I'll draft PR to infra/slo-policies.

Alex: Also want an explicit error-budget handling rule: canary should draw up to 50% of the main error budget while fixes are in flight, and auto-rollback if budget burns >20% within any 1h window. Is that realistic/acceptable?

Erin: The rollback config looks reasonable. For dashboard work I'll add a panel for error budget burn and one for p95. Queries I'll add:
```
# error budget burn %% (simplified)
100 * (1 - sum(rate(success_count[5m])) / sum(rate(request_count[5m])))
```
and
```
# p95 latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
I'll include threshold annotation lines at 300ms and 350ms and set an alert when p95 > 350ms for 10m.

Maya: Runbook edit: add a pre-warm step when KV miss rate spikes. Pseudocode to include in PR:
```
if kv_miss_rate > 0.05:
  run prewarm_kv.sh
```
I'll include a test plan and rollback instructions. Linking PR to SRE-346.

Alex: Timeline recap & owners (for the epic):
- SRE-345: dashboard PR (Erin) — ETA Thu EOD
- SRE-346: runbook PR (Maya) — ETA Fri
- SRE-347: canary policy PR (Alex) — ETA Mon
I'll own follow-ups and run the weekly check-ins until stabilization, then we'll archive the epic. Also setting a recurring 30m follow-up for 2 weeks.

Erin: I'll also add a short how-to in ops/dashboards/slos.md that explains the new panels and how to interpret the error-budget burn gauge.

Maya: Thanks — I'll add the test plan and link the prewarm script to CI. @Alex please assign owners in the epic so notifications go correctly.

Alex: Done — epic updated, owners assigned, PR placeholders created. Closing action items in this thread for now. Ping if you hit a blocker. :thumbsup:
